warp_image_between_views: warp target images to the reference view using depth maps and camera intrinsics and extrinsics
generate_warping_field: generate a warping field to sample one frame into another using depth and camera parameters
reproject_points_between_cameras: reproject 3D points from a reference camera coordinate system to a target camera coordinate system
convert_pixels_to_camera_rays: convert pixel coordinates to normalized camera rays using focal length and principal point intrinsics
project_points_to_pixels: project 3D points in camera space to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics
